sources.title: Harbor 2.0 release notes
sources.license: Original synthetic demo, MIT. Not a real package advisory.
sources.text:
Removed `retry_limit`; configure `retry_policy` instead.
Deprecated `legacy_auth`; it remains available until version 3.0.
Added `export_batch` for bulk report exports.
Fixed an authentication bypass in `session_check`.
Corrected a sorting bug in `list_orders`.

sources.title: Harbor 2.0 configuration reference
sources.license: Original synthetic demo, MIT. Not a real package advisory.
sources.text:
The `retry_limit` setting remains supported in version 2.0.
The `retry_policy` setting controls retry delays and maximum attempts.
The `export_batch` API supports JSON and CSV output.
The `legacy_auth` adapter is deprecated but still works.
